mapper.select: SELECT ap.rel_id, ap.article_id, ap.product_id, ap.package_name, ap.package_image, ap.package_price, ap.sort_order, tp.product_name, tp.main_img_url, tp.price, tp.product_status FROM article_package ap LEFT JOIN tour_product tp ON ap.product_id = tp.product_id WHERE ap.article_id = #{articleId} AND tp.product_status = 1 ORDER BY ap.sort_order ASC
